burnbarIntegration.migrationPolicy: New Signal-backed private-domain writes must use this manifest and the shared bridge; existing HPKE/CloudVault envelopes remain legacy read-only until migration telemetry proves old rows are gone.

submoduleFork.rationale: Security remediation M-6. The Vendor/libsignal git submodule is the OFFICIAL signalapp/libsignal v0.94.4 tree (basedOnOfficialCommit) plus exactly ONE build-integration commit (xcframework packaging for the OpenBurnBar Signal FFI). It MUST NOT diverge from official in any crypto-core file (rust/, java/, node/, etc.). scripts/ci/verify-libsignal-submodule-delta.sh enforces this allow-list in CI so a crypto-core change can never enter via the personal fork unnoticed.
